cells.action: Add the freshness grade to the knowledge bundle (D3 27ad96a5, D8 4148025d) exactly by the Grade rule and the Seeding paragraph in plan.md Approach. New module verbs/knowledge/freshness.rs exports: (1) `bundle_root(root, feature: Option<&str>) -> PathBuf` — the docs/knowledge directory of the checkout the command runs in, built the way drivers/close.rs `docs_root_for_feature` picks a granted worktree's tree (anchor: `pub(crate) fn docs_root_for_feature(root: &Path, feature: &str) -> PathBuf {`); every knowledge verb that reads or writes concepts (check, list, search, show, context, new, seed-anchors, confirm) resolves its bundle through it, so a command run inside a granted worktree reads and writes that worktree's docs tree; (2) `grade_bundle(checkout_root, concepts) -> BTreeMap<rel_path, Grade>` and `grade_concept(checkout_root, rel_path, bee: &Map<String, Value>) -> Grade` where `Grade { grade: confirmed|suspect|orphan|unverified, verified_at: Option<String>, verified_commit: Option<String>, anchors: Vec<String>, changed: Vec<String>, reason: Option<String> }` — the signature takes the bundle-relative path and the parsed `bee` map, not walk::Concept, so the session preamble's own Concept type can call it; implement the one-pass rule from plan.md: one `git log --format=%H --name-only --first-parent -m <oldest verified_commit>..HEAD` through verbs/worktree/git.rs `run_git` (anchor: `pub(crate) fn run_git(cwd: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> GitOut {`) plus one `git merge-base --is-ancestor <vc> HEAD` per distinct verified_commit, never a git call per anchor; a concept's repo path for the same-commit exemption is `docs/knowledge/<rel>`. Three frontmatter fields under `bee`: `anchors` (flat list), `verified_at` (ISO date), `verified_commit` (full sha); every write goes through the canonical emitter (frontmatter.rs `emit_scalar` / `is_plain_safe`) and a written file must report zero not_canonical. In check.rs, after the profile pass, grade every concept under areas/ only (never patterns/, never work/, never index.md) and emit: text summary line `freshness: <n> confirmed, <n> suspect, <n> orphan, <n> unverified`; `--json` object `freshness: {confirmed, suspect, orphan, unverified, rows: [{path, grade, verified_at, verified_commit, changed, reason}]}`; one profile WARNING per suspect concept (code `stale_anchor`, message naming the changed anchors and the remedy `knowledge confirm --id <bee.id>`) and per orphan concept (code `orphan_anchor`, naming the missing path and the remedy: fix bee.anchors); unverified is counted, never warned; when areas/ has concepts and none carries bee.anchors, print one NOTE `no concept carries bee.anchors — run bee knowledge seed-anchors once`. Two new single-token verbs routed in routing.rs (anchor: `"check" => run_check(flags, json, pre_json, t0),`) and declared in generated/registry_payload.json as `{name, invoke, description}` rows beside `knowledge.check` (round-trip the JSON keeping its byte format): `bee knowledge seed-anchors [--dry-run]` walks areas/ only and, for every concept with NO `bee.anchors` key, collects the backticked repo-relative paths in its body that exist under the checkout (same backtick-path shape `dangling_source_candidate` accepts), skipping any path under `.bee/`, `docs/`, or containing a `/generated/` segment; writes them as `bee.anchors`; sets `bee.verified_commit` to `git log -1 --format=%H -- docs/knowledge/<rel>` and `bee.verified_at` to that commit's ISO date (a concept with no commit gets anchors only); prints per-file counts and how many concepts got zero anchors. `knowledge confirm (--id <bee.id>)+ | --path <repo path>` stamps `verified_at` (today, UTC) and `verified_commit` (current HEAD of the checkout) on each named concept, or on every areas/ concept whose anchors contain --path; refusals, each naming its remedy: unknown id → `no concept with bee.id <id> — bee knowledge list`; concept with no anchors → `<path> has no bee.anchors — run bee knowledge seed-anchors or add anchors`; --path matching no concept → `no concept anchors <path>`; confirm never clears orphan and says so when the grade stays orphan.
